go_test_errors: main.go:12:2: package musicbubbles/sandbox is not in std
found packages main (bubble.go) and sandbox (note.go) in workspace

root_cause.detail: The CE portfolio requires a flat root Go layout containing main.go and all production .go files while also declaring module musicbubbles/sandbox without an explicit same-directory package invariant. Director split the flat root into package main and package sandbox and made main.go import the module root, which Go rejects.

repair_behavior.observed: QA physically edited package declarations but alternated between package main and package sandbox without reducing the two-error topology contradiction.
repair_behavior.why_repair_cannot_author_topology: Repair cannot safely choose between two contradictory layouts because CE immutable authority did not choose one executable package topology.

repair_coverage.decision: Prevent the infeasible portfolio in chief_engineer.blueprint before adding any Director regex rule.

planned_fix.invariant: When PM-authoritative Go production targets and main.go share one directory, CE must project an explicit package-main/no-self-import topology constraint into the shared project interface contract consumed by every Director task.
planned_fix.unit_evidence: 178 CE public contract tests passed; ruff, mypy, diff-check passed

secondary_residual.evidence: TaskRuntime event file stayed bounded near 2 MB, but owner rows retained multi-megabyte audit payloads and backend reread volume approached 10 GB during the run.
